verdict.rationale: SumUp ships an official @sumup/sdk JavaScript package that wraps its API, includes TypeScript declarations, runs in Node.js 18+, Cloudflare Workers and Vercel, and has documented code examples. Reader SDKs for Android and iOS in-person payments and an Agent Toolkit for LangChain, AI SDK and OpenAI Agents round out the SDK coverage. missing for 10: evidence of official server SDKs in languages beyond JavaScript, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
